Constructor stores the base result/relevance, optionally computes duplicate status when DUPE_SEARCH is enabled, and inserts the base result as child. addChildResult rejects a child whose user already appears; otherwise it appends under lock. getChildren returns a copied list under lock; hasUser checks child users. getHits is child count; getConnectionSpeed sums child connection integers; getSlots sums free/total slots; getOldestDate returns minimum child date. getContentInfo returns the first initialized child info or falls back to base result info by reference. getFileName returns the unique most frequent child name, falling back to base name on a tie. getTotalRelevance is hits*sourceScoreFactor+matchRelevance. pickDownloadResults copies children and applies SearchResult::pickResults up to MAX_AUTO_MATCH_SOURCES. File download attempts each selected child, retaining the first successful BundleAddInfo and the last exception text; if all fail it throws Exception(lastError). Directory download attempts each selected child, collects successful DirectoryDownloads, logs per-child failures, and throws Exception(lastError) if none succeed. Remaining value getters delegate to base result for directory flag, token/TTH, size, ADC path, base user/IP, or stored duplicate/relevance fields.
errors: File and directory download methods throw Exception only when no candidate was successfully queued; file failure reports the last caught error, directory failure also reports the last caught error.
behavior.completion: Aggregation and selection return synchronously. Child-list operations take the static FastCriticalSection; download attempts are sequential over selected child results.

ownership_evidence: GroupedSearchResult retains shared pointers to base/children. getChildren returns a copied list retaining shared pointers. getContentInfo, getTTH, path, user and IP getters return references owned by retained result/user state.
threading_evidence: The static FastCriticalSection protects child list reads/writes. Download dispatch occurs after copying selected children and outside the child-list lock.
records.proposed_bridge_requirement: Preserve duplicate-user suppression, aggregate values, tie fallback for filenames, source selection limit/order, and partial-success download semantics. Keep returned borrowed references anchored by retained result state.

inputs: String query and string projection callback at construction; T values passed to match; result count passed to getResults.
effects: Construction builds a NAME_PARTIAL SearchQuery. match projects each item to a name; if query.matchesStr succeeds, inserts the item with SearchQuery relevance score into a multiset ordered by descending score. getResults returns up to the requested count in multiset order without removing stored matches.
errors: No error return is exposed by these methods; callback behavior is supplied by the caller.
